correctness.rationale: All 6,211 nonempty faces are exhaustively reconstructed. A 3,102-pair matching is checked against all 30,360 Hasse covers and is acyclic. The only critical dimensions are 0, 4 and 5 with multiplicities 1, 1 and 5. Exact signed gradient-path recursion gives zero for each of the five Morse boundary coefficients from dimension 5 to dimension 4. The degree classification of maps \(S^4\to S^4\) then gives the wedge. A separate full mod-2 chain calculation yields reduced Betti ranks 1 and 5 in dimensions 4 and 5 only.

value.rationale: The Desargues graph is a canonical highly symmetric cubic graph, the Levi graph of the Desargues configuration and the bipartite Kneser graph \(H(5,2)\). Determining its exact independence-complex homotopy type gives a natural mixed-dimensional benchmark not supplied by the general bipartite suspension theorem or by known edge-ideal invariants, and it contrasts structurally with nearby named-graph independence complexes concentrated in one sphere dimension.
